messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Regression output with SEM
parts:
This forum is about lavaan.  It sounds like you are using principal components analysis, which is only related to exploratory factor analysis, not CFA.  

https://stats.stackexchange.com/questions/1576/what-are-the-differences-between-factor-analysis-and-principal-component-analysi

You did not ask a specific question.  What does this have to do with SEM?  If you have questions about other R functions (or even lavaan), you can ask them at CrossValidated (see the link above).  This forum is really for solving software problems (e.g., you get a lavaan error you don't understand) or asking about a feature for which you don't know the lavaan syntax.  If you have general SEM questions , you can post on SEMNET:

https://listserv.ua.edu/cgi-bin/wa?SUBED1=semnet&A=1
